item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder class is missing the Error method that is referenced in several tests. The error handling implementation is incomplete and doesn't properly handle exception types.
item.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder class must implement an Error method that creates a Result.Error instance with the appropriate error type. Additionally, the _send method must properly handle exceptions by converting them to Result.Error instances instead of raising them directly.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder's _send method doesn't properly handle StopAsyncIteration exceptions. The tests expect StopAsyncIteration.value to be accessible but the current implementation doesn't handle this correctly.
item.contract: The _send method in AsyncResultBuilder must properly extract values from StopAsyncIteration exceptions when they occur in async generators. Specifically, if StopAsyncIteration has a value attribute, it should be returned as the result instead of raising the exception.

item.description: The generic Builder class has issues with async generator handling. It needs to be enhanced to properly support async generators and their termination conditions.
item.contract: The _send method in Builder must properly detect and handle async generators, ensuring that async generators are processed with __anext__() instead of send(), and that StopAsyncIteration is handled correctly for async generators.

item.description: The AsyncResultBuilder is missing proper awaitability handling for Result objects yielded within async generators. It should await Result objects that are yielded and properly unwrap their values.
item.contract: The _send method in AsyncResultBuilder must detect when yielded values are awaitable Result objects and properly await them, extracting their values for further processing.

item.description: The Result class needs to properly handle awaitable behavior for async contexts. The __await__ method needs to be improved to properly handle various scenarios.
item.contract: The __await__ method in Result class must properly handle both Ok and Error cases, ensuring that when an Error is awaited, it raises the error properly instead of returning it.
